sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: In the story 'The Old Stag', why did the stag feel proud when he looked at his reflection in the water?
Identify the subject in the sentence: 'The little boy ran across the busy street.'
Who invented a special reading and writing system for visually impaired people?
Replace the underlined noun with the correct pronoun: '_The children_ are playing in the park.'
Identify the correct article to fill in the blank: My mother bought ___ umbrella because it was raining.
According to the chapter 'Be Smart Be Safe', what is the most important rule before crossing a road?
options: A) Run as fast as you can
B) Look left, right, and left again
questions.answer: B) Look left, right, and left again

questions.question_text: Identify the helping verb in the following sentence: 'She is writing a letter to her friend.'
Which of the following shows the correct possessive form for 'the book belonging to the girl'?
Choose the correct verb to complete the sentence: The dog ___ barking loudly at the stranger.
What does the phrase 'Together we can' signify?
options: A) Working alone is always best
B) Teamwork makes tasks easier and better
C) Never ask for anyone's help
questions.answer: B) Teamwork makes tasks easier and better

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Why did the villagers in 'The Tinkling Bells' think there was a ghost in the forest? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The villagers heard strange sounds of tinkling bells coming from the dark forest at night, making them believe a frightening ghost was living there.

questions.question_text: What is the main message of the poem 'One Thing at a Time'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The poem teaches us that we should give our full attention to whatever we are doing, instead of trying to do many things simultaneously.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence by replacing the nouns with correct pronouns: 'Rahul told Sita that Rahul and Sita should study together.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: He told her that they should study together. Pronouns like 'he', 'her', and 'they' replace the repeated names to make the sentence sound much better.

questions.question_text: Change the following declarative sentence into an interrogative sentence: 'The students are reading a new storybook today.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Are the students reading a new storybook today? To make it a question, we simply move the helping verb 'are' to the beginning of the sentence.

questions.question_text: Correct the error in the sentence and explain your grammar rule: 'The box of chocolates are empty.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct sentence is 'The box of chocolates is empty.' We use the singular verb 'is' because the main subject of the sentence is the singular noun 'box'.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are the old stag trapped in the bushes. Describe how your opinion about your legs and antlers changed at that moment. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: When my beautiful antlers got caught in the thick bushes, I realized they were dangerous to me. Meanwhile, my ugly, thin legs helped me run fast to escape the hunters. I learned that being useful is far more important than just looking beautiful.

questions.question_text: How did Louis Braille's invention change the lives of visually impaired people around the world? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Louis Braille created a brilliant system using raised dots on paper. This allowed visually impaired people to read and write by running their fingers over the dots. His invention gave them the freedom to learn, gain knowledge, and communicate easily with others.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a short formal application to your class teacher requesting permission to sit in the front row because you cannot see the blackboard clearly from the back. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Teacher, I am writing to inform you that I have been having trouble seeing the blackboard clearly from my current desk at the back of the class. I kindly request you to please allow me to sit in the front row so I can focus on my studies. Thank you.

questions.question_text: Describe a busy morning in your school playground using at least three action verbs and three common nouns. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The school playground is very energetic in the morning. Children run across the green grass while holding colourful bags. Some students jump rope near the large trees, and others throw a rubber ball to their friends. The loud bell rings, and everyone quickly walks towards their classrooms to study.
